opis: Napeto postane, ko morata Holmes in Watsonova združiti moč z Garethom Lestrado, Sherlockovim nekdanjim sodelavcem s Scotland Yarda, da bi preiskali bombni napad.
reziser: Jonny Lee Miller, Aidan Quinn, Helen Shaver
igralci: Jonny Lee Miller (Sherlock Holmes), Lucy Liu (Dr. Joan Watson), Lucy Liu (Joan Watson), Aidan Quinn (Captain Thomas Gregson), Jon Michael Hill (Detective Marcus Bell), Jordan Gelber (Dr. Eugene Hawes), John Noble (Mr. Morland Holmes), John Noble (Morland Holmes), Ophelia Lovibond (Kitty Winter), Nelsan Ellis (Shinwell Johnson), Ato Essandoh (Alfredo Llamosa), Tim Guinee (NSA Agent McNally)
